sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, face Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite their recent loss, Sandbach remain strong leaders and will be heavy favourites against second-bottom Alsager Town, who have won just once all season and are on a poor run. This is a chance for Sandbach to bounce back immediately and extend their lead at the summit.
divisionWide: Saturday's matches across the division see several significant clashes. Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town, a fixture that could see them close the gap on leaders Sandbach if they win. AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a meeting of two of the league's stronger sides, with both eyeing a push up the table. Wolverhampton Casuals at home to Wednesfield Community should favour the visitors given recent form disparities. Bilston Town (5th) welcome Foley Meir in a mid-table encounter, while New Mills face Market Drayton Town in a battle between struggling sides. Crewe host Allscott Heath in another lower-table affair, Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a fixture between two of the league's poorest performers, and Shawbury United (on a six-game losing streak) host Barnton. Wednesday's midweek encounter sees Brereton Social, winless in three league games, host Wednesfield Community.
